description: Ministry of  Labour and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes between T. N. Mohotti Galle and other Part Southern Provincial Road Development Authority - Galle
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters as it contains an order under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing an arbitrator to settle an industrial dispute. The content focuses on statutory procedures and legal authority rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
